canary-cmake-ctest.body:
# Canary CMake and CTest integration

## First actions

```console
canary query -c ext.cmake.overview
canary query -c ext.cmake.ctest
canary query -c ext.cmake.cmake_module
```

## CTest integration

Canary can read `CTestTestfile.cmake` through the CTest JSON interface and create Canary specs.

Useful flow:

```console
canary run path/to/build/tree
canary status
canary log JOBID
```

## CMake helper module

The `Canary.cmake` module can generate `.pyt` wrappers from CMake:

- `add_canary_test`
- `add_parallel_canary_test`
- `add_canary_test_options`
- `add_canary_test_target`
- `write_canary_config`

## Common issues

- CMake must be new enough to support `ctest --show-only=json-v1`.
- CTest resource groups require a compatible Canary resource pool.
- Some CTest properties are intentionally warned as unsupported.
